reason: Primary purpose is user-visible account-balance display in the sidebar settings panel: it adds a balance widget beside the Settings button and refreshes it on schedule or on click. Evidence in README shows a host route that queries provider balance APIs and a client UI slot injection, indicating a UI/financial-status feature rather than developer tooling or general automation.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏设置区域显示当前 LLM 提供商的账户余额，并支持自动与手动刷新。
summaries.en: This plugin shows the current LLM provider account balance in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar settings area and supports periodic automatic refresh with manual refresh on click.

capabilities: Reads provider credential references via the host credential mechanism
Makes outbound network requests to provider balance endpoints
Injects a custom element into the sidebar settings area with auto/manual refresh behavior

reasons.code: The plugin defines a host route (/account-balance) that resolves provider settings and fetches account balance from a provider API.
The client half renders a sidebar settings-area balance box and implements 5-minute auto-refresh plus manual refresh on click.
Manifest/package metadata exposes a bundled host/client plugin model for the web client and includes credential-related peer dependency usage context.
